## Definitions

- [statement] Event Relay is a managed path from Salesforce platform events and change data capture events to Amazon EventBridge; it is not a direct relay to arbitrary brokers. (high confidence) — https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/platform/api-metadata/references/meta-types/metadata-eventrelayconfig.html · keywords: Salesforce Event Relay and external broker alternatives for case alerts · also: https://architect.salesforce.com/docs/architect/decision-guides/guide/event-driven, https://developer.salesforce.com/blogs/2022/10/salesforce-event-relay-is-generally-available
- [statement] Event Relay is a Salesforce-managed subscription that delivers events to Amazon EventBridge. It provides basic relay monitoring; EventRelayFeedback exposes relay status and errors. (medium confidence) — https://developer.salesforce.com/blogs/2022/10/salesforce-event-relay-is-generally-available · keywords: Salesforce Event Relay and external broker alternatives for case alerts · also: https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/platform/object-reference/references/standard-objects/object-eventrelayfeedback.html
- [statement] Kafka is an external-broker alternative: Confluent documents a fully managed Salesforce Source V2 connector with Pub/Sub CDC ingestion, while OSO publishes an Apache-2.0 Kafka Connect suite with Pub/Sub CDC streaming. These are separate connector choices. (medium confidence) (verified as of 2026-11-12) — https://docs.confluent.io/cloud/current/connectors/cc-salesforce-source-v2.html · keywords: Salesforce Event Relay and external broker alternatives for case alerts · also: https://github.com/osodevops/kafka-connect-salesforce-oss

## Problems, failure modes and limitations

- [statement] When a relay cannot resume after its last delivered event, its default LATEST recovery starts with new events; EARLIEST resends retained events, whose retention is up to three days. (high confidence) — https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/platform/api-metadata/references/meta-types/metadata-eventrelayconfig.html · keywords: Salesforce Event Relay and external broker alternatives for case alerts · also: https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/platform/object-reference/references/standard-objects/object-eventrelayfeedback.html
- [statement] EventRelayFeedback can be queried for relay status and error messages; no events are forwarded during ERROR, and Salesforce periodically attempts recovery. (low confidence) — https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/platform/object-reference/references/standard-objects/object-eventrelayfeedback.html · keywords: Salesforce Event Relay and external broker alternatives for case alerts
- [statement] Confluent CDC Source can duplicate events after an unexpected stop because it resumes from its last recorded replayID. Events beyond Salesforce’s 72-hour retention window cannot be recovered from that event stream; Kafka ingestion does not remove the upstream outage window. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-11-11) — https://docs.confluent.io/cloud/current/connectors/cc-salesforce-source-cdc.html · keywords: Salesforce Event Relay and external broker alternatives for case alerts
- [statement] A relay in ERROR sends no events and periodically attempts recovery. PAUSED also stops delivery; resumption continues from the prior position only while retained events remain available. Monitor relay state as part of alert delivery operations. (low confidence) — https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/platform/object-reference/references/standard-objects/object-eventrelayfeedback.html · keywords: Salesforce Event Relay and external broker alternatives for case alerts
- [statement] Confluent warns that Source V2 cannot directly migrate CDC Source custom-channel configurations or Streaming API replay-ID semantics. It requires idempotent downstream applications during cutover to handle potential duplicates. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-11-11) — https://docs.confluent.io/cloud/current/connectors/cc-salesforce-source-v2.html · keywords: Salesforce Event Relay and external broker alternatives for case alerts

## Facts and statements

- [statement] Salesforce documents Event Relay support for custom high-volume platform events, real-time event monitoring events, and change data capture events; standard platform events and standard-volume custom events are excluded. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-11-12) — https://help.salesforce.com/s/articleView?id=platform.ev_relay_feature_support.htm&language=en_US&type=5 · keywords: Salesforce Event Relay and external broker alternatives for case alerts
- [statement] PAUSE preserves relay state; STOP deletes current state. EventRelayFeedback documents that resuming a paused relay continues from the last position only within the retention window. (high confidence) — https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/platform/api-metadata/references/meta-types/metadata-eventrelayconfig.html · keywords: Salesforce Event Relay and external broker alternatives for case alerts · also: https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/platform/object-reference/references/standard-objects/object-eventrelayfeedback.html
- [statement] Confluent documents a fully managed Salesforce Source V2 connector that sends Salesforce data to Kafka, supports real-time CDC through Pub/Sub API, and offers Bulk API 2.0 polling and historical loading. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-11-12) — https://docs.confluent.io/cloud/current/connectors/cc-salesforce-source-v2.html · keywords: Salesforce Event Relay and external broker alternatives for case alerts
- [statement] OSO’s Apache-2.0 Kafka Connect repository advertises a source using Pub/Sub API for CDC and platform events; this establishes an open-source candidate, not independently verified production reliability. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-11-12) — https://github.com/osodevops/kafka-connect-salesforce-oss · keywords: Salesforce Event Relay and external broker alternatives for case alerts
- [statement] Event Relay supports custom high-volume platform events and change data capture events. Its support does not extend to standard platform events or standard-volume custom platform events. (medium confidence) (verified as of 2026-11-12) — https://developer.salesforce.com/blogs/2022/10/salesforce-event-relay-is-generally-available · keywords: Salesforce Event Relay and external broker alternatives for case alerts · also: https://help.salesforce.com/s/articleView?id=platform.ev_relay_feature_support.htm&language=en_US&type=5
- [statement] An Event Relay becomes an EventBridge partner event source. After connecting it to an event bus, EventBridge rules can filter events and route them to targets. This supplies the AWS routing stage for an external case-alert pipeline. (low confidence) — https://developer.salesforce.com/blogs/2022/10/salesforce-event-relay-is-generally-available · keywords: Salesforce Event Relay and external broker alternatives for case alerts

## Research summary — Salesforce Event Relay and external broker alternatives for case alerts

For case alert delivery outside Salesforce, Event Relay supplies a managed forwarding path to Amazon EventBridge. Kafka connectors supply another integration path, including Confluent’s managed connector and an OSO open-source candidate. Relay recovery options, pause versus stop behavior, and queryable error state affect whether downstream alert processing receives missed events. Broker selection therefore requires explicit recovery and monitoring choices; a connector’s existence or vendor reliability claim does not prove lossless alert delivery.
